summary: First test iteration for Urban Fresh. Backend pytest suite (21 tests across catalog, enquiries, admin auth, inventory CRUD, enquiries/stats/settings) 100% pass. Frontend Playwright flows (12/12) pass on desktop: home + curation filter + add-to-cart badge + order-now drawer, hamper detail (qty, view toggle, add-to-cart, policy), fruit builder (variant, add bucket, shelf add, tabs, review -> checkout), checkout invalid-phone rejected and valid-phone success with ref UF1004, admin login + nav through all 5 pages + inventory add modal + logout. Mobile 390x844 verified for home, hamper detail, fruit builder, admin login - no horizontal overflow. Slack notified=false and settings-test-slack 400 behave as spec'd.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py starting to get large (~480 lines); consider splitting into routers (public, admin_auth, admin_inventory, admin_enquiries) before adding more endpoints.
notify_slack logs 'skipping notification' as INFO on every enquiry when webhook blank - fine for dev, consider rate-limited log or single startup warning.
ADMIN_PASSWORD read from env and bcrypted on first startup only; rotating ADMIN_PASSWORD in .env has no effect unless admins collection is cleared - worth documenting.
Enquiry ref 'UF{1000 + count + 1}' uses count_documents which is race-prone under concurrent inserts; acceptable for current traffic but note for scale.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed - backend auto-seeds admin + 6 hampers + 8 fruits + settings on startup. Test created a few TEST_ enquiries/customers and TEST_ hampers/fruits (all cleaned by DELETE at end of each CRUD test). One UI-created hamper 'TEST UI Hamper XZ' may remain in DB from the admin inventory add UI test - main agent can delete via admin panel if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend+frontend suite in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, parallel-safe, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Public preview URL working. Note: a leftover 'TEST UI Hamper XZ' hamper may exist from UI test; also several TEST_ enquiries/customers in DB (customers keyed on test phones +919812345678 / +919800000111 / 9876543210). First iteration found zero defects.
